technical-summary: Cold Radiance CI builds fan out: compiler-cache keys carry the upstream pin; a lookup-only probe detects a cold pin; staged lane builds (BC_LANE_STAGE=engine | component:NAMES) compile the engine and components on parallel runners against a header-only engine prefix and hand on the cache entries they wrote; the build job merges them and runs warm. Warm builds stay one job. Cache prune follows the new key format.
user-summary-candidate: CI builds after a Radiance pin bump run in parallel jobs instead of one hour-long job.
